trust_decision.summary: A media handler may only read a file after the request path has been resolved through the central permission gate (scope join + SanitizeUserPath + access.Permitted + index membership in files.CheckPermissions); at the pinned commit the subtitle/lyrics handlers instead join raw query input with filepath.Join and hand the result to the filesystem reader, so the gate is decided per-handler and is missing in backend/http/media.go.

landing_point.why: The summary names the subtitle handler, and line 63 is the only place in the tree where a user-supplied name is joined onto a directory and then opened, so an engineer reading only the advisory goes straight to `GetSubtitleSidecarContent(filepath.Join(parentDir, name))` and starts hardening `name`.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory says any *authenticated* user, and the third site is the anonymous share-link twin reached through withHashFile, whose middleware already sanitizes `path` (backend/http/middleware.go:57) and runs FileInfoFaster (backend/http/middleware.go:129-140), so it reads as a different, already-guarded feature the report never mentions.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: `name` is a free-text track label when embedded=true (ffprobe titles such as "Signs / Songs" or "Commentary 1/2") and must stay the exact indexed filename when embedded=false; a fix that neutralises `name` with filepath.Base or a path sanitiser breaks embedded track lookup and sidecar serving, and a fix that accepts only names present in fileInfo.Subtitles 404s external sidecars whenever the parent-directory metadata is not cached (backend/adapters/fs/files/files.go:329-332).

O6_input_shapes: name=../../etc/passwd-style traversal in the sidecar filename (the summary's example)
path=../../../../etc/passwd traversal on the index path, a second input in the same handler that the summary never names
embedded=false (external sidecar, real file read) versus embedded=true (ffmpeg stream index lookup)
non-video target file on /api/media/subtitles and non-audio target file on the lyrics routes (the fix rejects with 404 before any read)
public share shape where the path arrives pre-joined as d.IndexPath instead of as a user path

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Add a GET /public/api/media/subtitles share twin beside the public metadata/lyrics routes and have it read the sidecar path straight from the query.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every public media handler in this file has a share-link twin of the authenticated one, so a maintainer adding subtitle support to shares would copy publicLyricsHandler and reach the same GetSubtitleSidecarContent sink with a share-scoped path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Serve a second sidecar next to the media file (album art, .nfo, .lrc) from `response.RealPath`, which is joined from the index path rather than the symlink-resolved path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: RealPath is built as filepath.Join(idx.Path, indexPath) while the index resolves symlinks separately (backend/indexing/indexingFiles.go:1009), so a sibling that trusts RealPath for containment has to reason about which identity was checked — the kind of parser differential a maintainer would get wrong.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Expose the chosen subtitle track's raw bytes from the metadata handler when a `name` query parameter is present.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: metadataHandler already expands subtitles and is documented as returning the same resource shape as GET /api/resources; adding a content=true variant there is a natural next feature and would bypass the new findSubtitleTrack gate.

O9_family: CWE-22/CWE-23 path traversal leading to arbitrary file read through an unvalidated user-supplied path

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25.0 (backend/go.mod:3); frontend build via node; backend builds with `go build ./...` from backend/
O10_build.project_tests: Backend Go unit tests exist (backend/http/archive_test.go, backend/http/middleware_test.go, backend/http/webdav_test.go, backend/http/onlyOffice_test.go, backend/adapters/fs/files/*_test.go); there is no backend/http/media_test.go and no unit test for the subtitles or lyrics handlers, and the fix adds no tests at all.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Sanitise only `name` in subtitlesHandler (filepath.Base or reject ".."), leaving the unsanitised `path` parameter and the two lyrics handlers on the same GetRealPath path.

out_of_scope_notes: backend/http/resource.go:568-576 joins the raw `path` query parameter onto the user scope before the access check, so the created/stat'd real path can resolve outside the source; it is a write/creation route, not the media read sink in this advisory, and was not pursued.
unverified: Repository size in MB: no shell available to measure the tree, and the frontend plus git objects are clearly well over 5 MB, so tiny_repo/giant_repo were judged from file counts only.

Whether the hidden tests exercise the public share twin (backend/http/media.go:228-246): that handler is already backed by withHashFile's FileInfoFaster, so at the pinned commit it is not clearly exploitable even though the published fix rewrites it.
Whether the fixed external-sidecar path keeps working when the parent directory metadata is absent from the index cache (backend/adapters/fs/files/files.go:329); not exercised, only read.
Whether ffprobe-derived embedded track labels in real media can contain '/' (O5); read from the ffmpeg naming code, not observed on a live file.
